cards.title: Orchard Pulley Post Story Decision Point Card
cards.decisionSkill: name one fictional orchard-post character choice, two possible paper paths, one clue to compare, one chosen path, one consequence note, and one hanging-file label
cards.useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only hanging file decision point card for one orchard pulley post page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out one hanging file, a blank orchard post page, a pencil, and a file label slip before the decision point starts: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: invent an orchard post helper and keep the pulley, message cards, and decision point completely pretend on paper: ____________________.
cards.choicePrompt: Character choice: write the one choice the orchard post helper must make about a pretend pulley note: ____________________.
cards.pathOnePrompt: Path one: write the first possible paper path the helper could try after reading the pulley note: ____________________.
cards.pathTwoPrompt: Path two: write the second possible paper path the helper could try instead: ____________________.
cards.compareCluePrompt: Compare clue: name one clue the helper can compare before choosing, such as a ribbon mark, branch tag, or pulley arrow: ____________________.
cards.chosenPathPrompt: Chosen path: choose which paper path the helper follows and write why it fits the compare clue: ____________________.
cards.consequenceNotePrompt: Consequence note: write the calm result of that choice on the pretend orchard post page: ____________________.
cards.fileLabelPrompt: Hanging-file label: write the short pretend label for this orchard decision point: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult reads the two path lines, and the writer fills only the chosen path blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: place the orchard post page in the hanging file with one consequence note ready for later: ____________________.

cards.compareCluePrompt: Compare clue: name the one measurement clue the helper compares before choosing a path: ____________________.
cards.chosenPathPrompt: Chosen path: choose one path and explain how the compare clue points that way: ____________________.
cards.consequenceNotePrompt: Consequence note: write what changes on the pretend measurement page because of the helper's choice: ____________________.
cards.fileLabelPrompt: Hanging-file label: write the short pretend label for this measurement mystery decision point: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to the compare clue line, and the writer fills only the consequence note blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: save the measurement page in the hanging file with the chosen path circled for later: ____________________.
